findings.title: Golden scenarios change: ask-conflict-strategy impact_scope uses src/aiflow and becomes REVIEW; review-workflow-change gains a rule id; examples/scenarios not in scope
Treat any segment containing *, ? or [ as a wildcard segment; otherwise [s]rc/** is read as a literal and routes AUTO
Name the load-time validation for overlaps_paths values (schema if/then or Policy cross-file check)
Governance list omits tools/ci/**, .ai/bootstrap-mode.yaml, .ai/tasks/**, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, pyproject.toml, uv.lock
Reuse normalize_repository_path (rejects '.', absolute, empty) and casefold both sides
missing:error blocks synthetic routing test units without impact_scope; rule priority unspecified

summary: Checking decision-unit impact_scope is sufficient (classification requires impact_scope within allowed_scope; AUTO commits are limited to AUTO-unit impact_scope; attestation/worktree changes must be governance-only) and segment-prefix overlap is conservative, but the golden-unchanged acceptance criterion is unattainable, wildcard segments must include ?, [ as well as *, load-time validation needs a named mechanism, and the governance list misses paths that steer CI or rules.
